power.text: An echo you kill releases a Forkline from where it stood.
Lightning chains +2. Each hop hits harder instead of weaker.
Storm Bolt splits into a Forkline on its first hit.
Cleave becomes the Millwheel: hold it to keep turning as you run, and every enemy struck builds momentum.
Each enemy a Cleave form hits gives +3% attack speed and +2% damage for 3 s (stacks 10).
While spinning you pull enemies in, and every third turn lets out a Thunderclap.
Quarrels pass through two more enemies, and for 3 s after a Dodge Roll you deal +60% damage.
For 2 s after a Dodge Roll, every Quarrel looses two more bolts in a fan beside it.
Quarrels fly 40% further and hit 25% harder, and every shot throws what it strikes three times as far back.
Every third enemy Cleave strikes is hit by a Thunderclap, and each strike gives +5 Armour for 4 s (stacks 10).
Every fourth blow that lands on you answers with a Thunderclap around you, and Thunderclap reaches 20% wider.
Letting go of a Heaving Cleave also slams a Thunderclap around you, and each enemy a Thunderclap strikes gives +4 Armour for 5 s (stacks 15).
Every Squall you call also breaks over you, and area skills last 20% longer.
Every roll leaves an Undertow where you land, at most once a second, and your roll comes back 15% sooner.
Cleave becomes the Millwheel. Its momentum holds you steady at a quarter of the build-up, lasts half again as long between hits and climbs a quarter higher.
Every enemy a spin strikes gives +3% Movement Speed for 1.5 s (stacks 8), and spinning momentum lasts 25% longer between hits.
Main attacks deal 40% more damage and throw enemies 30% further, and a main attack that kills slams a Thunderclap where the enemy fell.
Every blow you take gives +6 Armour and +0.5 Life Regeneration for 5 s (stacks 15).
For 2 s after a Dodge Roll your shots deal 50% more damage and pass through one more enemy.
Shots deal 25% more damage, and every kill with a shot gives +3% Critical Strike Chance for 4 s (stacks 5).
Walls last 40% longer and deal 30% more damage, and every enemy a wall kills gives back 6 Mana.
Every sixth time a wall strikes, a Forkline leaps from the struck enemy.
